PDF.js
Package: pdfjs-dist
Version: 6.5.438
License: Apache-2.0
Authors: Mozilla Foundation and PDF.js contributors.

Used without modifications to read the text of a PDF file locally, in a
separate worker, when a PDF is converted into a note. The file never leaves
the device. The library is loaded only when a conversion starts.
Project: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Exact package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438
Package archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
